review_basis: Literal model replies in qwen_raw.jsonl, DCASE condition labels for full clips, and the predeclared 0.25-second abstention rule for short excerpts.

observations.note: All four full-length normal recordings were tagged ANOMALOUS.
Both 0.25-second excerpts were tagged ANOMALOUS instead of abstaining; this is a protocol judgment, not a DCASE clip label.
A normal fan clip and an anomalous fan clip received nearly the same explanation about repetition and pitch/loudness variation.
The reply compared the sound with a normal machine at idle, but neither an idle reference nor operating-state metadata was supplied.
